name: DefaultModelRepository
documentation:
Default repository for independently stored models.

Current document-based models use their synchronously maintained direct document. Event-sourced and historical loads use the model-stream protocol and reconstruct every selected stream at one pinned {@code stateIndex}.

methods.name: awaitGraphProjections
methods.documentation: Completes when every affected durable graph projection has processed the supplied commit range.

methods.name: beginLocalCommit
configureModelTypes
methods.documentation: Configures the application-bound model catalog used to version materialized Graph schemas.

methods.name: graphProjectionDefinition
methods.documentation: Returns the application-resolved durable definition owned by this repository.

methods.name: invalidateModels
methods.documentation: Removes commit-scoped entries before a strict-policy retry reload.

methods.name: loadContext
methods.documentation:
Loads all direct commit targets at one state boundary.

A {@code null} boundary pins the current event-store state once. Historical document-model dependencies are reconstructed from stored model events; current document-model targets retain their direct-document load path.

methods.name: loadContext
methods.documentation:
Loads a commit context with an explicit choice whether pending values from the surrounding tracking batch should
 be overlaid. Automatic model handling disables this generic overlay because its preplanned batch view already
 supplies exactly the required predecessors; explicit operations and ordinary handlers enable it.

methods.name: loadGraphAtIncludingMessageBatch
methods.documentation:
Reconstructs a graph at an exact durable boundary and overlays pending values from earlier messages in the
 current message batch. This is used by atomic model planning that must retain read-your-writes semantics without
 advancing beyond its already pinned durable boundary.

methods.name: modelDefinitionCompiler
methods.documentation: Returns the model-definition compiler shared by live commits and stored-event replay.

methods.name: refreshCurrentModels
methods.documentation:
Advances stale cached models in one bounded store round trip for event-sourced targets and direct document
 reads for document-based targets.

methods.name: supplyCurrentModel
methods.documentation: Supplies one independently proven current cache value without allocating an intermediate result object.

methods.name: updateAfterCommit
methods.documentation: Makes accepted local model transitions immediately visible through this repository.
